Korean letters will be drawn later by game code, so leave the center EMPTY: absolutely NO text, NO letters, NO numbers, NO symbols, NO emblems, NO icons inside.

Match the existing game art that was inspected: el_fire.png and basic.png: bold cartoon mobile-game look, flat cel shading with 3 to 4 tones per color, big glossy highlights, a THICK dark navy outline #0b1322 around every coin shape, chunky shapes, no fine detail. Square 1024x1024.
